Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW detailed landscape illustration for the CM2 educational app Les ateliers de Liam. The attached image is a reference for the exact three fictional characters and painterly adventure-book style, not an edit target. Keep Liam (brown tousled hair, freckles, linen shirt), Maelle (red braid, pale blouse and small red vest) and Remus (dark curly hair, blue shirt) recognizable and the same age. They are exploring a clear turquoise stream on the edge of their leafy medieval-fantasy village. Liam carefully observes pebbles and water with a magnifying glass, Maelle sketches observations in a notebook without any readable text, Remus checks a simple wooden measuring stick beside the bank. Their expressions are curious, thoughtful and friendly. Show the actual activity clearly, no magical effects. A small stone bridge and fresh greenery, pale stone buildings far behind, open blue sky. Fresh blue, green and white with restrained red accents, no dominant brown or beige wash. Crisp hand-drawn detail and beautiful natural daylight, coherent anatomy and hands. Medium-wide composition with all three faces visible in the central horizontal band, suitable for educational cards and an unframed chapter banner. No text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, frame, or watermark. Landscape 1536x1024.
